_notes: Game setup defaults (design doc section 3). seed 0 means pick a random seed. player_race is the race of the human player's faction (see races.json). Generation: ocean_fraction is the share of ALL tiles that becomes salt water (ocean, plus coast wherever ocean meets land, so land never touches ocean directly); edge_ocean_width/strength push oceans toward the map edges. The other *_fraction values are shares of the LAND tiles, assigned by noise rank. Lakes are inland only; each lake gets a river to the sea, and river_sources extra rivers start in hills or mountains and run to the nearest water.
